notes.title: update 0.3.3
notes.notes:
I was working on the procedural storytelling system (aka Meta-event system). 
The player will face emergencies, and unexpected situations (events) and make decisions that affect gameplay. The system is implemented but events are not set up yet.
Events will be progressively added in the following updates.
A modding interface will be implemented to add custom events in JSON format.


 Updated UI graphics.
 First setup of the procedural storytelling.
 Bugfixes.

 Bug fixes.


I will proceed with the Procedural storytelling system.

notes.title: update v0.2.1
notes.notes:
-Added options menu for resolution/volume adjustment ( resolution changes take effect after restart)
-Added shields modules
-Added computer modules
-Adjusted tech progression
-New contamination/hazard mechanics: chemical, biological, radiological, and cognito-hazard status can be applied to Astros and ships. These effects are reduced with time.
-Hazards reduce base food production and can kill the population.
-Cognito-hazards reduce base production.
-Cognito-hazard in ships reduce accuracy and evasion.
-Ships now gain experience that increases hazards resistance, accuracy, and evasion.
-Adjusted fleet management interface.
-Subspace travel unlocks subspace dimension view. Subspace engine available.
-Subspace can cause cognito-hazard. 
-improvements of AI
-added more weapons (bombs)
